name: Day Spa (Botanical)
tagline: A warm, botanical template for day spas — book online from day one.
description: A warm, botanical day-spa site — an oat-and-cream palette, a deep eucalyptus primary and a soft serif, with unhurried, restorative copy and natural light carrying the page. Installs a working booking flow: a real treatment menu (Swedish, deep-tissue and hot-stone massage, aromatherapy facial, body scrub, couples massage and a sauna session), three therapists booked by name with their own hours, three treatment rooms, and a cancellation policy. Ships as "Verdure", a calm garden sanctuary.
